credits.description: Credits held while the request is reserved, charged once it is settled; 0 when free or released.

partial.description: Present during active research when the account is active and the key has reports:read: the instant report, limited to the plan. Polling does not charge another lookup.

refresh.description: Set true to request new research instead of the stored report, using the account's credits when starting a new run. Joins research already in progress. Use a new Idempotency-Key for a new refresh operation.

Usage.description: The account's credits this month, shared across its keys and with the website.

balance.description: Monthly and extra credits left; below zero when research cost more than the account had.

available.description: The balance less the credits held for research in progress: what new requests may use.

monthly.description: Monthly credits left; they end when the month does.

extra.description: Extra credits left; they carry over.

renewsOn.description: When the next month's credits are granted (Europe/Zurich).

schemaVersion.description: Original research snapshot schema version. Report fields use the normalized public API shape.

employeeCountBasis.description: Where the headcount comes from: an official filing, the company itself, a third party such as the press, or an estimate.

employeeCountUnit.description: Whether the headcount counts people or full-time positions; null without a headcount.

employeeCountScope.description: The entity the headcount describes, as its source names it: the company itself or, for example, its group.

mandates.description: Roles the company's registered officers hold or held at other companies, from those companies' commercial register notices. Filled from the register only; empty in reports before it was looked up.

registerNotices.description: Every commercial register (SOGC) notice of the company, newest first. Filled from the register only; empty in reports before it.

mandateLookups.description: How far each registered officer's roles at other companies were looked up; empty when they were not looked up.

personName.description: The person the source names with these details; null for a channel of the company or one of its departments.

channel.description: For details that reach the company or a department rather than a named person: what they reach, such as "Main office", "Media", "Investor relations", "Customer service" or "Human resources"; null for a person. Null in reports before channels were recorded.

schemaVersion.description: Original research snapshot schema version. Report fields use the normalized public API shape.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. The amount must be expressed in base currency units; do not put scales such as million or billion in this field.

revenueFact.description: The company's revenue: the most recent full financial year found, with the period it describes and where it comes from.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. The amount must be expressed in base currency units; do not put scales such as million or billion in this field.

basis.description: Where the figure comes from: an official filing, the company itself, a third party such as the press, or an estimate.

structuredMandateClaim.description: firstSeenOn is the earliest register notice found naming the person there: the role existed by then even when its entry was not found.

personName.description: The officer, as named in this report's people.

roleTitle.description: The function as the other company's register notice states it; null when the notice states only a signature.

sogcIds.description: The other company's SOGC notices that name the person.

changes.description: What the notice changed, from its official change codes.

status.description: complete: every notice naming the person with the Heimatort was read; partial: only the newest, or some could not be read; failed: none could be read; not_searchable: no Heimatort or given name to search and match by; not_searched: beyond the number of officers looked up per report.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Put a separately evidenced scale or measurement label in unit, not in currency.

reliabilityScore.description: Backend-assigned source weight. Official register 100, company homepage 80, everything else 60. Model output must include the field; the backend overwrites it.

findings.description: Provisional findings: official register facts and the classifications settled so far from the sources read, each with its confidence. Replace with each snapshot; not verification or completeness.

origin.description: register: official commercial-register fact. classification: a classification settled from the sources read, labelled with its confidence (clear indication, likely, uncertain). extraction: text written from selected source passages, citation-checked.

sourceReading.description: Whether every source read so far could be assessed. attention_required: some could not; research continues and the completed report replaces this snapshot.

ResearchPartial.description: Instant report during research, never a completed report. Provisional findings may change or disappear; do not merge revisions. Personal research leaves are withheld until final verification. Latest revision replaces the previous one; the completed report supersedes all previews.
